title: From What to How: An Initial Review of Publicly Available AI Ethics Tools, Methods and Research to Translate Principles into Practices
reasoning: The entire paper is a systematic review of the landscape of AI ethics tools and methods. It evaluates how high-level ethical principles (beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy, justice, and explicability) are translated into practical tools for machine learning development, categorizing them into a typology and identifying gaps in the field.
